messages.subject: about saving plots as tiff
parts:
I have created a plot using ggplot2 and I want to save it as an image
in tiff format, here's the code for this process:

tiff("R.tif",
width=7.4,height=7.4,unit="cm",compression="lzw",res=600)
hgram
dev.off()

then the image looks weird because the character size seems very
large. However, if I change the size of the image to 17.4 cm, that is:
tiff("R.tif",
width=17.4,height=17.4,unit="cm",compression="lzw",res=300)

then the image looks just OK.

Could anyone tell me why did this happen?

Thanks a lot.

messages.author: 3651c4eb6da83745
messages.subject: Re: about saving plots as tiff
parts:
I used to wrestle with this issue, but recently switched to RStudio.

When the plot is complete it's very easy to preview as a TIFF/PDF/etc.
and change the font sizes with opts until everything looks right.
